semantic.justification: TaskFKYDT8 ports ScTabView SelectNextTab and SetTabNo sheet grouping from tabview3.cxx and SelectAllTables/DeselectAllTables from tabview2.cxx over real ScViewData/ScMarkData. Native WrapNextPrevSheetTab defaults true. Existing per-sheet cursor state survives navigation;normal selection retains a partial group on already-selected target sheets and collapses an all-selected group. Native Sfx slots26543,26544,26561,26562,26361,26365 use original operation/state boundaries. Navigation commits the real input draft first and rejected drafts prevent movement. Source group-only commands do not change model generation,dirty state or history. Shared CommandMenuBar executes real slots and browser Ctrl/Meta+PageUp/PageDown plus tab-arrow navigation use the same dispatcher. Hidden/alternate sheets,reference editing,drawing/window services and full native parity remain unported.
